QuestInfo.name: OSSS Mission 1: Alien Elimination
QuestInfo.1: Defeat #b20 Powerful Aliens, 20 Wise Aliens, and 20 Lucky Aliens, who appear when you defeat Unidentified Powerful Aliens, Unidentified Wise Aliens, and Unidentified Lucky Aliens, respectively#k and return to #bHead Researcher Wynn#k.\r\n\r\nYou must be wearing a #bBing Machine or a Visitor Suit#k to defeat the aliens.
QuestInfo.2: Receive this mission again after completing the other missions.

0.0: You've been issued a special mission from the OSSS. You can complete it if you have the #b#t4032714##k.

yes.0: I see that you have the #b#t4032714##k. I will issue you Mission 1.
yes.1: Aliens have been appearing throughout Maple World. Please defeat #b20 Unidentified Powerful Aliens, 20 Unidentified Wise Aliens, and 20 Unidentified Lucky Aliens.#k
yes.2: Remember, aliens can't be hurt if you're not wearing the Bing Machine.
yes.3: You will get a medal when you complete the mission. Talk to #b#p9250135##k to upgrade your suit using those medals.

no.0: Idle chat can wait until after you've saved Maple World...

yes.0: Thank you for your work. Here is your medal. Head over to #b#p9250135##k to purchase various cells that can be used to upgrade your suit.
yes.1: And as for the #b#t4032718##k, submit it with the other ones once all four missions have been completed.
